summary: Iteration 53 — Phase 3 Infrastructure module (Auto-Allocator + Capacity Planner) is fully green end-to-end. BACKEND: 25/25 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_53_infrastructure_phase3.py. POST /api/infrastructure/allocate with required=4 returns exactly 4 inboxes from 4 distinct domains (avg_inboxes_per_domain=1.0), eligible_count=16, response shape verified (account_id/email/domain/ownership/daily_limit/remaining_capacity/status) and no Warming/Paused/Risky/Reserved leakage. required=20 caps allocated at 16 and emits 'Insufficient eligible capacity' warning. domain_capacity_floor=9999 → allocated=0 + all eligible domains in skipped_domains_near_exhaustion. min_remaining_per_inbox=1000 → allocated=0 (all test inboxes capped at ≤100). Validation 422 fires on required=0/-1/10001. POST /api/infrastructure/planner with {leads:50000,steps:4,duration_days:30,sending_days_per_week:5} returns status='Insufficient Capacity' with exact math: total_emails=200000, sending_days_in_window=21, required_daily_volume=9524, required_inboxes=191, available_inboxes=16, additional_inboxes_required=175, median_daily_limit=50, domain_diversity=5; warnings include 'Need 191 inboxes ... Add 175 more to fit'. Small order {leads:1000,steps:3,duration_days:60} → 'Ready' with required_inboxes ≤ available_inboxes and no 'Need X' warning. Planner validation 422 fires for leads=0, steps=0, steps=21, duration_days=0, sending_days_per_week=0/8. Non-permitted regular user → 403 on BOTH /allocate and /planner. Phase-1/Phase-2 regression green: /summary (window_days=120), /inboxes (18 rows, projected_window_total present), /calendar/{id} (120 days), /export inboxes csv contains 'Projected (120d)' header, /campaigns /drip-campaigns /accounts /auth/me all 200. FRONTEND (live Playwright via Mongo session-injection): /infrastructure renders infra-allocator-section + infra-planner-section (both open by default, toggles collapse/expand correctly — confirmed by re-querying allocator-required-input after collapse → null). Allocator with required=4 → exactly 4 allocator-row-{account_id} rows from 4 distinct domains (bulk.test.1@example.com / info@listpmm.com / dhruvmathur208@gmail.com / info@listingheds.in). allocator-copy-btn copies all 4 emails to clipboard (verified via navigator.clipboard.readText) AND switches to 'Copied' state. Allocator required=20 → allocator-warnings panel shows 'Insufficient eligible capacity — only 16 inboxes allocatable out of 20 requested (16 eligible after filters).' Planner with 50000/4/30 → planner-status-insufficient red badge + planner-warnings list + planner-additional-needed shows 175. Planner with 1000/3/60 → planner-status-ready green badge. Phase 1/2 regression: nav-infrastructure present, 6× card-*-inboxes, 4× card-cap-{today,week,30d,120d}, 18× inbox-calendar-btn, calendar-dialog + calendar-heatmap open correctly. Non-permitted user (can_access_infrastructure=False) → redirected to /dashboard.

action_items: No functional issues — Phase 3 Infrastructure module (Auto-Allocator + Capacity Planner) is shipping-ready.

Minor (carried from iter-52): the long-standing emergent visual-editor `<span data-ve-dynamic>` hydration warning still surfaces on the Domain Capacity / Inbox Availability tables. Same artefact, not introduced this phase, optional to silence.

Optional code-review nit (non-blocking): infra_phase3.py `_allocate` sorts intra-domain rows by `(-remaining_capacity, projection_total_or_sum)` — the secondary key tries `__total__` first then falls back to `sum(values)`. Since `__total__` is never set by build_projection, the `int(... or 0)` short-circuits to 0 and then falls through to the sum. Works correctly but the dead `__total__` lookup adds 1 line of misdirection; cleanup welcome but harmless.
critical_code_review_comments: infra_phase3.py (~273 lines) — small focused module, two pure helpers (_allocate, _plan) + attach_phase3_routes. Closure-passing of (_load_inboxes, build_projection, aggregate_capacity) avoids circular import with infrastructure_routes — clean.

_allocate diversification correctness verified at runtime: with 16 eligible inboxes across 5 domains, required=4 picks 1 per domain across the 4 domain-pools with the deepest depth (example.com=11 inboxes is included by virtue of being the first domain in the deep-first round-robin, then listpmm.com, gmail.com, listingheds.in). Domain ordering by `-len(eligible_domains[d])` is intentional and correct for the deepest-pool-first heuristic.

Pydantic validation: required ge=1/le=10000, min_remaining_per_inbox ge=0/le=10000, domain_capacity_floor ge=0/le=10000 — leads/steps/duration_days/sending_days_per_week all bounded. 422 enforced as expected.

_plan: total_emails = leads*steps, sending_days_in_window = round(duration_days * sdpw/7), required_daily_volume = ceil(total_emails/sdiw), required_inboxes = ceil(daily_volume/median_daily_limit). Math validated end-to-end with the 50k/4/30 spec (→ 200000/21/9524/191) and the small 1k/3/60 case (→ Ready).
median_daily_limit falls back to 50 when there are zero eligible inboxes — sane default; verified the planner does NOT crash on an all-warming workspace.

Domain diversification warning trips when eligible_inboxes>0 and domain_count<=4 — fires for 50k/4/30 with diversity=5 actually NOT triggering this branch (correct, threshold is ≤4); 'Need X inboxes' warning fires correctly.
Phase-2 regression intact: /summary capacity numbers unchanged (window_days=120 still default), /inboxes still returns projected_window_total, calendar 120 rows.

Frontend Infrastructure.jsx: AllocatorSection + PlannerSection cleanly mounted at the bottom of /infrastructure, both default-open, toggles unmount inner content (not just hide). Copy-to-clipboard uses navigator.clipboard.writeText + temporary 'Copied' label state — clean UX feedback. PlannerStat grid is responsive (2/3/4 cols). All testids requested in the review brief are present.
Pre-existing lint warnings (set-state-in-effect lines 88+149) noted in the brief are unchanged and were not aggravated by Phase 3 additions.
